title: Pleated Satin Sleeveless Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant satin midi dress features a clean V neckline, structured bodice and full flowing skirt for a timeless, feminine look. The polished silhouette flatters the waist while hidden pockets add everyday ease. Perfect for wedding guests, cocktail parties, rehearsal dinners, formal dinners and semi formal celebrations, this classic midi dress moves beautifully from day to night.

?

Size Tip: Please choose your size based on bust and waist measurements. If your bust and waist fall into different sizes, we recommend choosing the larger size.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
